application.description: Wraps the angular application builder with driver conditions.

dev-server.description: Wraps the angular dev server builder with driver conditions from a @daffodil/commerce:application build target.

unit-test.description: Wraps the angular unit test builder with driver conditions from a @daffodil/commerce:application build target. Only the vitest runner is supported.

sync.description: Modifies application build conditions for the specified driver versions.
